definitions.explanation: An area that experiences exceptionally heavy snowfall. In Japan, this is also a legally designated category covering large parts of {東北|とうほく}, {北陸|ほくりく}, and {北海道|ほっかいどう} that receive special government support.

examples.japanese: {新潟|にいがた}は{豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}だ。
examples.english: Niigata is a heavy snowfall region.

examples.japanese: {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}では{屋根|やね}の{雪|ゆき}{下|お}ろしが{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: In heavy snowfall regions, clearing snow off the roof is essential.

examples.japanese: {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}に{指定|してい}された{地域|ちいき}は、{除雪|じょせつ}{費|ひ}などについて{国|くに}の{支援|しえん}を{受|う}けることができる。
examples.english: Areas designated as heavy snowfall regions can receive government support for snow removal costs and other expenses.

notes:
Compound of {豪雪|ごうせつ} (heavy snowfall) + {地帯|ちたい} (zone/region). Beyond its descriptive meaning, this is an official designation under the 1962 {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}{対策|たいさく}{特別|とくべつ}{措置法|そちほう}, covering more than half of Japan by area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}に{指定|してい}される: to be designated a heavy-snowfall region
- {豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}の{暮|く}らし: life in snow country
- {特別|とくべつ}{豪雪地帯|ごうせつちたい}: special heavy-snowfall region (most severe designation)

RELATED WORDS:
- {豪雪|ごうせつ}: heavy snowfall
- {雪国|ゆきぐに}: snow country (more literary)
- {除雪|じょせつ}: snow removal
- {雪|ゆき}{下|お}ろし: clearing snow from a roof
